name: Windows Defender LSASS Scan
description: Microsoft Defender (MsMpEng.exe) reads lsass.exe memory during a routine scan. GrantedAccess 0x1410 and TargetImage lsass.exe match the rule's suspicious-access selection, but SourceImage is MsMpEng.exe, which the rule's filter_av_products exclusion removes. This exercises the NOT(...) filter logic - the rule must NOT fire.
